Name: No-Miss Interact---Harvest-Interact at Full Speed
Author: neoiw
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#8CC63F][b]No-Miss Interact（不漏收）[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][i][color=#E8D9A0]Harvest every machine while you run — no automation, no missed kegs, and crab pots no longer glue you in place.[/color][/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]The Problem[/color][/b][/size]
Vanilla Stardew Valley repeats the action button in fixed [b]100ms[/b] steps ([i]10Hz[/i]) and only ever checks the single tile in front of you. Hold the button and [u]run along a row of kegs, preserve jars or other machines[/u] and that slow sampling drifts against the tiles you pass — so [b][color=#FF4F4F]machines in the row get skipped[/color][/b] and you have to walk back.

Crab pots are worse in a different way: harvesting one plays a ~0.4s arm-raise animation that [u]blocks your movement[/u], so running along a crab-pot row is impossible.

[size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]The Fix[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The repeat interval becomes [b]configurable[/b] ([b]5–100ms[/b], default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]11ms[/b][/color][/size], [b]100 = vanilla[/b]) — [u]every machine in the row is reliably hit[/u].[/*]
[*]While you are moving, a machine [b]rejecting[/b] your input (e.g. a furnace without coal: red message + "cancel" sound) [u]no longer halts your footsteps[/u]. Message and sound unchanged.[/*]
[*]Crab pots: [b]the arm-raise animation no longer locks you[/b], and [b]one interaction harvests the whole ring[/b] around you (8 neighbours + the tile you stand on).[/*]
[*]Empty crab pots: hold bait and [b]one interaction refills the whole ring[/b] — only pots that are empty and unbaited, one bait each, stops when your bait runs out. It never picks pots up.[/*]
[/list][quote][b]Not automation:[/b] each repeat is one ordinary interaction with one target, exactly like vanilla — nothing is collected unless you hold the button, and your reach is unchanged. Every new behaviour has its own switch and can be turned off individually.[/quote][size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Configurable repeat interval[/b] — 5–100ms, default [b]11ms[/b] ([b]100 = vanilla rhythm[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]No more stumbling on rejections[/b] — machine rejections no longer stop your run.[/*]
[*][b]Per-target acceleration switches[/b] (2.1.0) — turn acceleration off for any individual target: crab pots, chests, trees/tappers, crops & tilled soil, NPCs & animals, buildings, everything else, plus [u]every machine in the game's machine list[/u] (so modded machines are included automatically). A disabled target strictly follows the vanilla rhythm.[/*]
[*][b]Crab pot enhancements[/b] (2.2.0) — no animation lock, and harvest the whole surrounding ring in one interaction. Two independent switches.[/*]
[*][b]Bait refill in a ring[/b] (2.3.0) — one interaction refills all empty pots around you; bait is consumed by the vanilla code.[/*]
[*][b]All input paths covered[/b] — keyboard action key, mouse right-click, gamepad A.[/*]
[*][b]In-game config[/b] via Generic Mod Config Menu (optional), or plain [i]config.json[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Bilingual UI[/b] (English / 简体中文), follows your game language.[/*]
[*][b]Split-screen & multiplayer safe[/b] — input and cooldowns are tracked per player; no network code.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]Tips[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The mushroom log (「蘑菇树桩」in Chinese) is a [b]machine[/b], not a tree — it is listed in the machine switches if you want it to follow vanilla timing.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]Configuration[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]. Master switch (restart to take effect).[/*]
[*][b]RepeatIntervalMs[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]11[/b][/color][/size]. Repeat interval while the action button is held, in ms. Range [b]5–100[/b]; [b]100 = vanilla[/b].[/*]
[*][b]NoHaltOnMachineReject[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]. Machine rejections don't halt your footsteps while moving.[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotNoAnimLock[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]. Harvesting a crab pot doesn't lock your movement.[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotHarvestAround[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]. One interaction harvests the whole ring of crab pots around you (radius 1).[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotBaitAround[/b] — default [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]. One interaction refills every empty crab pot around you (needs bait in hand).[/*]
[*][b]DisabledAccelerateTargets[/b] — default empty. Targets listed here are never accelerated (the GMCM switches just edit this list).[/*]
[*][b]EnableDebugLog[/b] — [b]false[/b]. Low-frequency diagnostic logging.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b] and Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract into your [i]Mods[/i] folder (you get a [i]NoMissInteract[/i] folder).[/*]
[*]Launch the game through [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b].[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to change settings in-game (title screen → Mod Options).[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#D98A2B]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
Tested on Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] + [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b] with a heavily modded setup. One Harmony transpiler patch in the input loop plus three postfixes (action routing, machine rejections, crab pots). No network code. [b]Split-screen:[/b] each local player keeps its own cooldowns (verified by running a second screen in-process); the actual two-human split-screen session still deserves your own test.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#E8D9A0]中文说明[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]问题[/color][/b][/size]
原版「按住动作键」固定每 [b]100ms[/b] 重复一次交互（[i]10Hz[/i]），而且每次只判定面前一格。按住动作键[url=沿酒桶/罐头瓶等机器列快速跑动]沿酒桶/罐头瓶等机器列快速跑动[/url]时，采样节奏和你经过的格子错位——[b][color=#FF4F4F]整排机器被跳过[/color][/b]，只好回头补收。

蟹笼还有个独立问题：收一台会播约 [b]0.4 秒[/b]的抬手动画，期间[url=人物被按住不能动]人物被按住不能动[/url]，所以沿蟹笼列跑收基本做不到。

[size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]修复[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]重复间隔改为[b]可配置[/b]（[b]5~100ms[/b]，默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]11ms[/b][/color][/size]，[b]100 = 原版[/b]）。[/*]
[*]跑动中被机器[b]拒收[/b]（如炉子缺煤：红字 + cancel 音效）[url=不再钉住脚步]不再钉住脚步[/url]；红字与音效照常。[/*]
[*]蟹笼：[b]不再被抬手动画按住[/b]，并且[b]一次交互收齐周围一圈[/b]（8 邻格 + 脚下那格）。[/*]
[*]空蟹笼：手持鱼饵时[b]一次交互把一圈空笼一起补上[/b]——只补「空的且没饵」的笼，每台消耗 1 个鱼饵，饵用完即停；[b]不会把笼捡起来[/b]。[/*]
[/list][quote][b]不是自动化：[/b]每次重复触发都是一次普通交互，只作用于一个目标——你不按住键，它什么也不会收；也不扩大交互范围。上面每一条新行为都有独立开关，可以单独关掉。[/quote][size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]功能[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]重复触发周期可配置[/b]：5~100ms，默认 [b]11ms[/b]（[b]100 = 原版节奏[/b]）。[/*]
[*][b]跑动中不再被拒收打断脚步[/b]。[/*]
[*][b]逐目标加速开关[/b]（2.1.0）：蟹笼、箱子、树/采集器、耕地与作物、NPC 与动物、建筑、其它，以及[url=游戏机器表里的每一台机器]游戏机器表里的每一台机器[/url]（装了其它 Mod 新增的机器也会自动列出来）都能单独关闭加速。关掉的目标完全按原版节奏走。[/*]
[*][b]蟹笼增强[/b]（2.2.0）：不被抬手动画按住 + 一次交互收一圈，两条独立开关。[/*]
[*][b]空蟹笼一圈补饵[/b]（2.3.0）：一次交互补齐周围一圈空笼，扣料仍走原版。[/*]
[*][b]三种操作方式都覆盖[/b]：键盘动作键、鼠标右键、手柄 A。[/*]
[*][b]游戏内配置[/b]：支持 Generic Mod Config Menu（可选），或直接编辑 [i]config.json[/i]。[/*]
[*][b]双语界面[/b]（简体中文 / English），跟随游戏语言。[/*]
[*][b]分屏/联机安全[/b]：输入与冷却按玩家各自记账，没有网络代码。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]小提示[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]「蘑菇树桩」是[b]机器[/b]（不是树），在机器开关清单里，想让它按原版节奏就关掉它那一条。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]配置项（config.json 或游戏内 GMCM）[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]，总开关（改后重启生效）。[/*]
[*][b]RepeatIntervalMs[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]11[/b][/color][/size]，按住动作键时的重复触发间隔（毫秒），范围 [b]5~100[/b]；[b]100 = 原版[/b]。[/*]
[*][b]NoHaltOnMachineReject[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]，跑动中被机器拒收时不再打断脚步。[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotNoAnimLock[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]，收蟹笼不再被抬手动画按住。[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotHarvestAround[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]，一次交互收齐周围一圈蟹笼（半径 1）。[/*]
[*][b]CrabPotBaitAround[/b]——默认 [size=4][color=#8CC63F][b]true[/b][/color][/size]，手持鱼饵时一次交互补齐周围一圈空蟹笼。[/*]
[*][b]DisabledAccelerateTargets[/b]——默认空；列在这里的目标一律不加速（GMCM 里的开关改的就是这份清单）。[/*]
[*][b]EnableDebugLog[/b]——[b]false[/b]，低频诊断日志。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]安装[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b] 与星露谷物语 [b]1.6[/b]。[/*]
[*]解压到 [i]Mods[/i] 文件夹（得到一个 [i]NoMissInteract[/i] 文件夹）。[/*]
[*]用 [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b] 启动游戏。[/*]
[*]可选：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，在标题界面左下角「MOD 选项」内改配置。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#D98A2B]兼容性[/color][/b][/size]
在星露谷物语 [b]1.6.15[/b] + [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b]（重度整合包）实测通过。一个输入循环的 Harmony transpiler，外加三个 postfix（交互路由、机器拒收、蟹笼）。没有网络代码。[b]分屏：[/b]每个本地玩家各自记账（用进程内拉起第二块屏验证过）；真·两个人操作的分屏仍建议你自己试一局。

Manifest.Name: No-Miss Interact（不漏收）
Manifest.Description: No-Miss Interact: prevent missed machine harvests when moving fast. 走路快时不再漏收机器：按住交互键沿机器列快速跑动时逐台收齐，不自动、不漏收；跑动中被机器拒收不再打断脚步。
Manifest.Author: braveturtle

Manifest.Name: No-Miss Interact（不漏收）
Manifest.Description: No-Miss Interact: prevent missed machine harvests when moving fast. 走路快时不再漏收机器：按住交互键沿机器列快速跑动时逐台收齐，不自动、不漏收；跑动中被机器拒收不再打断脚步。2.1.0 新增逐目标加速开关：每种机器/蟹笼/箱子/采集器都能单独关闭加速（关闭＝完全按原版节奏）。 2.2.0 新增蟹笼增强：收蟹笼不再被约 0.4 秒抬手动画按住，且一次交互收齐周围一圈蟹笼。 2.3.0 新增空蟹笼一圈补饵：手持鱼饵时一次交互把周围一圈空蟹笼一起补上。
Manifest.Author: braveturtle
